source: GAMC geoservices portal, project 04 'Adapting Farms with NASA Data - Agrotecnologia y Gestion del Agua para Agricultores' (https://recursosgamc.cochabamba.bo/api-doc), read on 2026-11-14
protocol: WMS 1.1.1 through the municipal proxy; read-only; GetMap, GetLegendGraphic (1.0.0) and GetFeatureInfo
note: The API key is not stored here. It is read from GAMC_API_KEY in .env and added by the server-side proxy.
